name: paper-md-viewer
description: Fast read-only Markdown viewer with a printed-paper look and KaTeX math.

paperMd.customCss.description: CSS appended after the built-in paper CSS.

paperMd.followPanel.autoOpen.description: Open the Paper MD follow panel automatically when a Markdown text editor becomes active. The panel reuses one webview, so switching files is fast.

paperMd.pdf.enabled.description: Show .pdf files in the Paper MD follow panel instead of a new tab. Needs paperMd.followPanel.replaceTextTab and the editor association "*.pdf": "default". The PDF tab is closed once the panel shows the file.

paperMd.html.enabled.description: Show .html and .htm files in the Paper MD follow panel instead of as text. Needs paperMd.followPanel.replaceTextTab. The page runs in a sandboxed iframe and reloads when you save the file.

paperMd.followPanel.replaceTextTab.description: Show the follow panel in place of the Markdown text tab (one tab, no side-by-side view). The text tab is closed; use the "Edit as text" button to read the file as text.

paperMd.tex.enabled.description: Show .tex files as a rendered approximation of the compiled paper in the Paper MD follow panel instead of as text. Needs paperMd.followPanel.replaceTextTab. No TeX engine is used: \input files, math, figures, tables and references are converted to HTML. Use the "Edit as text" button to read the source.

paperMd.tex.mode.description: How .tex files are shown (needs paperMd.tex.enabled). "html": converted to HTML without a TeX engine. "compile": the root document is compiled with latexmk on your local machine and the real PDF is shown; it is recompiled when you save a .tex, .sty, .cls or .bib file.

paperMd.tex.texPath.description: Folder with latexmk and the TeX engines. It is put in front of PATH when compiling.

paperMd.tex.maxMirrorMB.description: Compile mode copies the root's folder (TeX-related files only) to local disk. Stop and report when the copy would be larger than this many MB.
